sections.heading: History
sections.text:
At some point, Acidheart was used by Klaus against Dante Vale so that Klaus could return to his experiments for the Organization. [SAS-127]

Acidheart was used by Rassimov to attack Lok Lambert during the Huntik Foundation's assault on the Professor's castle, effectively cutting Rassimov's opposition down to just Dante Vale. [The Divine Comedy]

In the hunt for the Willblade in Avalon, Wilder targeted Lok with Acidheart, but the spell was reflected with Armorbrand. After Lok acquired the Willblade, Wilder again tried to hit Lok with Acidheart, but the spell was negated by the Willblade. [Knight of the Willblade]

Acidheart was used point-blank by Tantras when he deduced that Zhalia Moon was a spy. [Sophie on Trial]

During the assault on the Fortress of Iron Will, a Casterwill Hunter used the spell on LeBlanche, injuring him. Later, Tantras again used this spell to attack Sophie Casterwill and to buy time for Kiel. [The Spiral War]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Acidheart debuted in "The Divine Comedy" with a translucent violet aura and was nearly identical to Drybite. The coloration of Acidheart was changed for every subsequent appearance.
• In "Chasing Void", Wilder casting Acidheart in the previous episode re-appears as a flashback, though neither Lok nor Cherit witnessed it.

full_text:
Acidheart is a spell used to knock someone someone out by targeting the heart. This spell manifests as a spherical aura on the hand which emits a wavelike stream of green energy.

History

At some point, Acidheart was used by Klaus against Dante Vale so that Klaus could return to his experiments for the Organization. [SAS-127]

Acidheart was used by Rassimov to attack Lok Lambert during the Huntik Foundation's assault on the Professor's castle, effectively cutting Rassimov's opposition down to just Dante Vale. [The Divine Comedy]

In the hunt for the Willblade in Avalon, Wilder targeted Lok with Acidheart, but the spell was reflected with Armorbrand. After Lok acquired the Willblade, Wilder again tried to hit Lok with Acidheart, but the spell was negated by the Willblade. [Knight of the Willblade]

Acidheart was used point-blank by Tantras when he deduced that Zhalia Moon was a spy. [Sophie on Trial]

During the assault on the Fortress of Iron Will, a Casterwill Hunter used the spell on LeBlanche, injuring him. Later, Tantras again used this spell to attack Sophie Casterwill and to buy time for Kiel. [The Spiral War]

Trivia

• Acidheart debuted in "The Divine Comedy" with a translucent violet aura and was nearly identical to Drybite. The coloration of Acidheart was changed for every subsequent appearance.
• In "Chasing Void", Wilder casting Acidheart in the previous episode re-appears as a flashback, though neither Lok nor Cherit witnessed it.
